draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Irinjalakuda! Just down the road at Thazhekad is a stone inscription from the 8th to 10th centuries, one of the earliest surviving edicts granting privileges to the St Thomas Christians.
draft.hungryLine: This is paddy field country, so look for simple local meals in the villages around the station.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk about 20 minutes to Thazhekad and its St Sebastian church, one of the oldest in Kerala.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: The villages here are surrounded by paddy fields on all sides, part of the Thrissur kole wetlands. Just wander.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Thazhekad was once a prosperous inland port in the heyday of Muziris, until the great floods of 1341 changed the landscape.

legends.title: The bank of the Kallar
legends.body: Locals say a river called the Kallar once flowed here, and the land on its bank was called Kallarin kara. Over time that became Kallettumkara.

legends.title: The river that left
legends.body: The story goes that an earthquake changed the river's course. No river flows through Kallettumkara today, only its name remains.

tips.title: Take the train.
tips.body: All express and passenger trains except super-fast ones stop at Irinjalakuda railway station.

tips.title: Look for the Sasanam.
tips.body: At Thazhekad, ask to see the inscribed stone, one of the earliest records of the St Thomas Christians.

story.title: An inland port
story.body: Thazhekad was a prosperous inland port when Muziris was at its peak. It was home to one of the earliest St Thomas Christian communities in Kerala.

story.title: Church and stone
story.body: The Thazhekad St Sebastian church dates back to AD 800. The Thazhekad Sasanam stone is dated to between the 8th and 10th centuries.

story.title: The great floods
story.body: Huge floods changed the landscape here in 1341. Thazhekad's days as a port came to an end.

story.title: Tipu's army
story.body: Tipu Sultan's army ravaged the churches and temples of the area during his invasion of the south.

story.title: Pilgrims and paddy
story.body: Thazhekad church is the largest pilgrimage centre in the Irinjalakuda Diocese. Around it, villages sit among paddy fields and the Muriyad wetlands.
